_about: Gridiron keeper history. Edit after each keeper declaration; the next refresh picks it up. Ids are Sleeper player ids. 'keepers' lists every player kept that season; a player's escalation counts the consecutive seasons he appears here.
history_note: 2026 was the league's first season, so nobody was kept in 2026: every player's first keep costs one round earlier than his 2026 pick (undrafted: the last round).

rule.escalation: same as Maywood: each consecutive keep moves the cost one more round earlier than the last (-1, -2, -3 ...)
rule.undrafted: first keep costs the last round, then escalates the same way
rule.floor_note: a player whose cost would pass round 1 can't be kept
rule.draft_order: assumed reverse regular-season standings, snake (as Maywood) - confirm
rule.cost_follows_player: traded and dropped players keep their original draft cost
